described.alt_text: A naturalistic cartoon landscape of a blue lake between mountains, forested hills, a waterfall and a house with a red roof, signed 2023.
described.description: A square digital drawing inside a white border, with 2023 at bottom left and a signature at bottom right, no title lettering. A pale blue sky with outlined cumulus clouds sits over a distant range of grey blue mountains. A bright turquoise lake fills the middle distance with a small island. In front of it the land descends in hills of green trees, tan rock and pale blue water: a stream and small waterfall at centre left, a red roofed house with a chimney and smoke at centre right under a tall pine, a second house at far left, a lone bare tree at centre, and rocky orange and purple outcrops in the foreground with a red flowering bush at lower centre. Every form is outlined in fine black line and filled with muted natural colour, and the surfaces carry a soft printed texture.
described.impression: Unlike the rest of the series, nothing here has eyes. It is a storybook landscape, Hudson River School by way of a children's book, and it looks like a calm memory of a place rather than a party. Knowing it grew from the earlier Cliffs of Volcano Ball Lake through image generation and redrawing, it reads as the same valley revisited after everyone went home.
described.format_notes: Print file with white margin. Developed from the 2022 commission through Stable Diffusion variations and hand redrawing, as documented on the work in progress page.
